avoid.title: What to avoid
avoid.reminder: Gentle reminder: Balance is a practice, not a destination.

morning: Checking your phone before getting out of bed
Skipping breakfast or drinking coffee on an empty stomach
Intense cardio without warming up first
afternoon: Heavy meals that cause afternoon sluggishness
Stressful work emails during your break
Sitting without moving for more than 90 minutes
evening: Screen time and blue light before sleep
Caffeine or processed sugars in the late afternoon
Heavy meals within 3 hours of sleep
